C0278.title: Sentencing Issues in Web Crawler Crimes: Analysis of 88 Sample Cases
C0278.summary: In January 2023, China Court Network published an article analyzing 88 sample cases of web crawler crimes, finding that judicial practice tends to impose relatively lenient sentences.
